capability.name: OpenWAM plate to rack, inside to outside
capability.atomic_skill: Pick up exactly one named-color plate and place it onto the next available rack slot, filling slots from innermost to outermost.
capability.example_instruction: Place the blue plate onto the rack, filling the next available slot from innermost to outermost.
constraints: Preserve the user's color order, including repeated colors. Never silently rename a color.
One atomic task is one complete plate placement, including releasing the plate.
All steps retain the learned innermost-to-outermost placement order.
Arbitrary numbered slots, left-to-right placement and out-of-order slot access are unsupported in this profile.
If the requested object is absent or visually ambiguous, execution must stop for clarification.
Color selection and single-plate prompts require validation with the deployed checkpoint; this profile is not a claim of model accuracy.

preconditions: The named target plate is visibly available.
The rack has a plausible next free inside-out slot.
invariants: Preserve the identities and positions of already placed plates.
handoff_criteria: The named plate is released and remains stable in the intended rack slot.
The arm has withdrawn enough to start the next placement without disturbing the plate.
